overview.text: 那 commonly means “that” or “those.” It is linked to 𨙻, described as a state name; reuse for the demonstrative because of similar sound is proposed, but the old name’s pronunciation and the match are unverified.

components.text: 邑 contributes the city or place category in the traditional analysis of 𨙻.
冄 is assigned the sound role in 𨙻; its ancient depicted referent is uncertain.
